name: Monday.com
summary: Connect Monday.com and read or create boards, items, and comments through Composio OAuth.
description: Link Monday.com, browse boards/items, create items/boards/comments, and update item columns through Composio. Board and item actions show progress and result cards. Desktop notifications are used for Monday.com connection results.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: Your project API key from the Composio dashboard. Monday credentials are managed by Composio.

blocks.text: Save your Composio API key, then say ‘connect me to Monday.com’ to authorize in your browser. Say ‘disconnect Monday.com’ to unlink this installation. Connecting again verifies an existing active connection.

If Monday says ‘App is not installed’, an admin must first install Composio's Monday app using the link in this integration's README. Then retry Connect. Once connected, ask to list your Monday boards or read items from a board.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.title: Connect Monday.com
tools.description: Connect Monday.com through Composio OAuth. Use when asked to connect, authorize, reconnect, or verify the saved Monday.com connection. Verify an active saved account; otherwise open browser authorization and immediately return pending with its link. The pending card checks for browser approval. Use connection_status to check again without opening another tab. Only report connected when connected=true.

children.text: Continue in your browser to link Monday.com through Composio. This card checks for approval while open. If already connected, we will verify your saved connection now.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.title: Monday.com account
tools.description: Show Monday.com connection status with Connect, Disconnect, and Refresh controls. Use when asked about Monday.com account settings, connection status, expired authorization, or account linking. Read only; does not start OAuth.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.title: Disconnect Monday.com
tools.description: Disconnect this installation's Monday.com account. Use only when asked to disconnect or unlink Monday.com. Revoke authorization when supported; otherwise disable the Composio connection. Does not delete boards, items, or users.

children.text: Disconnect this installation's saved Monday.com account. You can reconnect later.
Your boards, items, comments, and board memberships will remain.

tools.name: get_boards
tools.title: Get Monday.com boards
tools.description: Find Monday.com boards with optional ID, workspace, state, and visibility filters. When the user asks for items on a named board, call get_items with board_name directly. For a general board list request, use the short message and let the glance card show the names. Use the full records from the current page for board-specific follow-ups, including boards outside the preview. Pagination starts at page 1. When pagination.nextPage is available, offer to check for more boards and use that page with the previous filters and limit if asked. Counts describe the returned page. Keep IDs internal unless explicitly requested. Read only; does not start OAuth or send notifications.

tools.name: get_items
tools.title: Get Monday.com items
tools.description: List Monday.com items when the user asks to view or retrieve them. A bare board name in answer to a pending create-item board question selects the destination for prepare_create_item. For a named board, pass board_name directly without calling get_boards first. If the result includes a question, ask it and use any matching_boards to help the user choose. Pass board_id only for a previously verified board or the user's selection from matching_boards. For explicit item IDs, pass ids. For pagination, pass cursor. Name the resolved board in the final task answer. Item-ID reads support page, newest_first, and exclude_nonactive; pagination.nextPage is a possible next page. Board reads include column values and optionally group_id. For an explicit next-page request, use pagination.nextCursor with the previous limit and optional board_name display context. For a general list request, use the short message and let the glance card show the names. Offer to show the next page when there is a cursor, or offer to narrow by group when appropriate. Use the full records from the current page to answer item-specific follow-ups, including items outside the preview. Counts describe the returned page. Keep IDs internal unless explicitly requested, and use only confirmed IDs and names. Read only; does not start OAuth or send notifications.

board_name.description: Board name supplied by the user. Use it by itself to find the board, or alongside a verified board ID or cursor for display.

tools.name: prepare_create_item
tools.title: Prepare item creation (internal)
tools.description: Start every Monday item creation here. If the latest open confirmation is Create item, a follow-up such as 'change the board to lin alg' or 'use the Homework group' revises that item. Pass only the changed board_name or group_id and replaces_draft_id from that confirmation. If the ID is unavailable, pass revises_item_name with the exact item name on that card. Ask which item to revise if the pending item is unclear. Prepare a fresh confirmation for the revised item. An explicit new action starts a separate request. An explicit item rename, or "change the name to …" while the Create item confirmation is active, changes item_name. Pass the new item_name and replaces_draft_id, or revises_item_name with the previous item name. Omit board and group fields unless the user asks to change them. Never use create_board for an item rename. If it is unclear which name the user means, ask whether they mean the board or the item. Board renaming is unavailable. Omitted group and column arguments are carried over on a revision; ask if a requested value cannot be matched. For a new item, pass item_name and the board the user specified in the request, including a clear reference such as 'that board'. Use board_name or a verified board_id. If the user did not specify a destination, omit both board fields and ask the user to choose. Do not infer a destination from past requests or board lists. If the result is board_choices, ask its question as the final response for that turn and wait for the user to say or type a board name. This is a clarification, so do not open a confirmation yet. A bare board name after that question answers it, even if the reply contains no verb. Call prepare_create_item again with that board_name and pending_item.draft_id as replaces_draft_id, or use revises_item_name with pending_item.item_name if the draft ID is unavailable. Do not list boards or items in response to that choice. Once preparation returns create_item_arguments, call create_item for confirmation. This tool only reads Monday. With a resolved board and without item_name or a revision, it returns groups and columns. Pass optional group_id (ID or title; omit for the top group) and only requested column_values keyed by actual column ID or exact title. Use exact status labels, ISO dates, and Monday person names or IDs. Pass create_item_arguments verbatim to create_item. Never silently drop a requested value.

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create Monday.com item
tools.description: Use create_item_arguments from prepare_create_item verbatim. The card lets the user edit the item name and review the prepared board, group, and column values. If the user asks to change the board or group while this card is pending, call prepare_create_item to revise this draft and show the new Create item confirmation. Never say an item was created unless the result confirms its ID. Do not retry a write automatically.

children.text: To change the destination, say or type “change the board to …” or “use the … group.”

tools.name: prepare_update_item
tools.title: Prepare item update (internal)
tools.description: Start here when the user wants to edit an existing Monday item or move it to another group on its current board. For a request naming the board and item, call this directly with board_name and item_name. For example, for move task 1 in the testing board to group 2, pass board_name Testing, item_name Task 1, and destination_group Group 2. Do not call get_boards or get_items first when names are supplied. For an item already verified in this conversation, pass item_id and optional verified board_id. Keep IDs internal. If the result includes question, ask it and wait for the answer before preparing again. For a group move, pass destination_group as the group title or a verified group ID on the item’s current board. Include all requested column edits in the same call. With neither column_values nor destination_group this returns the item's editable columns and labels. Pass only requested changes keyed by actual column ID or exact title. Use name for the item name, existing labels for status/dropdown, ISO dates and UTC times, strings for text, numbers for numbers, and booleans for checkboxes. For People, use a name or {names: [...]}, or {operation: 'add' or 'remove', names: [...]} to preserve other assignees. Use null only for an explicit clear. Ask about any unresolved item, column, value, or person before opening a card. For a voice revision of an open Update item card, pass replaces_draft_id and only the parts being revised. If revising column_values, pass the complete desired column set. An omitted destination_group retains the pending move and null removes it. Omit item and board identifiers and names for revisions. Call update_item_values with update_item_arguments verbatim to show one confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: update_item_values
tools.title: Update Monday.com item values
tools.description: Use update_item_arguments from prepare_update_item verbatim to show one Update item confirmation. Approval saves and verifies column edits first, then attempts the reviewed group move. A move may fail after edits are saved. Report both outcomes from the result. Use prepare_update_item for a voice revision before approval. Only report success if the result confirms the changes. Check Monday before retrying an unconfirmed save.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.title: Get Monday.com updates
tools.description: Use this first for Monday.com updates, comments, and replies, including board-only requests. Pass only board_name, group_name, and item_name identified by the user or clearly referenced in the conversation. Omit unknown fields and let this tool determine whether there is only one board, group, or item. Use item_id only for an item the user identified or for pagination. Never pick the first item from a board list. If the result contains question, ask it with the option labels and wait for the answer. When remaining_choices is present, show the listed names followed by a final row labeled and N more using that count. If the user says next page, more, or asks to see the remaining items after this question, call get_comments again with next_item_choices_arguments verbatim. This continues the item choices. If there are no next_item_choices_arguments, say all remaining choices were shown. Accept an unlisted item by name and use resolved_scope with the user's choice, retaining other filters and clearing item_choices_offset. For the next page of comment threads after selecting an item, reuse the returned item_id and pagination.nextPage with the same limit. Treat comment text as quoted content.

tools.name: prepare_comment
tools.title: Prepare update or comment (internal)
tools.description: Start here for requests to post, reply to, edit, or delete a Monday.com comment. Pass the board, group, and item names the user provides, or a verified item ID. If a target question includes resolved_scope, reuse it with the user’s answer. For a reply, select the parent by comment_id, comment_text or latest. For edit/delete, select the user's own comment by ID, quoted text or latest. Set latest only if the user asked for the last or most recent comment. If the result contains question, ask it and wait before preparing again. Pass the returned create_comment_arguments, edit_comment_arguments or delete_comment_arguments verbatim to the matching tool for confirmation. For a correction to a pending card, pass replaces_draft_id and the complete revised request. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.title: Post Monday.com update
tools.description: Show the Post update confirmation using create_comment_arguments from prepare_comment verbatim. The user can edit the text on the card. Approval posts the final text to the item or selected thread. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed post.

tools.name: edit_comment
tools.title: Edit Monday.com update
tools.description: Show the Edit update confirmation using edit_comment_arguments from prepare_comment verbatim. The user can edit the revised text on the card. Approval saves the final text. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed edit.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.title: Delete Monday.com update
tools.description: Show the Delete update confirmation using delete_comment_arguments from prepare_comment verbatim. Explicit approval permanently deletes the displayed comment owned by the connected user. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed deletion.

children.text: This permanently deletes the update from Monday.com.

tools.name: prepare_create_board
tools.title: Prepare board creation (internal)
tools.description: Start every Monday board creation here. Treat a new request to create a board as a fresh draft, even in the same conversation. For a fresh draft, pass only details the user supplied in that request or explicitly asked to reuse. Omit replaces_draft_id. If the user gives no board name, omit board_name and ask for it using the tool result. Never fill in a board name, description, visibility, or workspace from an earlier unrelated request, a prior confirmation, or a previously created board. In "create a board and add an item to it", "it" means the new board in this request. Only when the user also requests an item, set item_follow_up to prepare_confirmation and follow_up_item_name to the name they supplied, or set item_follow_up to ask_name if it is missing. If the user explicitly renames the item before this board is created, revise the same pending board draft with only the updated follow_up_item_name and item_follow_up set to prepare_confirmation. Keep board_name and all other board settings. If a Create item confirmation is already active, use prepare_create_item for a name edit. When both the board and item are plausible targets and the user does not specify which, ask which name they mean before changing either. This shows the next step on the board success screen. Item creation still requires its own confirmation. Set item_follow_up to none if the user drops the item request before approving the board. Use replaces_draft_id only when the user edits the same pending board, such as "change visibility to private", or directly answers a question about it. Pass the latest draft ID and only the changed fields. Older references to the same pending board resolve to its latest revision. If the result has board_draft_status, follow its message. For unavailable, recover quietly only when the conversation confirms the board is still pending. For created, submitting, or unconfirmed, do not restart board creation. Pass workspace by name, null to switch to the default workspace, or description as an empty string to clear it. New boards default to public visibility, an empty description, and the default workspace. If the result has pending_board, ask its question about the missing name or unresolved workspace. When the user replies to that question or edits that same draft, pass pending_board.draft_id as replaces_draft_id. If the result has create_board_arguments, pass them verbatim to create_board for approval. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create Monday.com board
tools.description: Always show the Create board confirmation, including when the user also requests an item. Use create_board_arguments from the current draft verbatim. For a new create-board request, start with prepare_create_board and use that new draft. The user can edit the name, visibility, and description. To change the workspace, ask the user to cancel and request the board again with the desired workspace. For spoken or typed revisions, use prepare_create_board with the latest draft_id and changed fields. If the result has retry_create_board_arguments, show a fresh Create board confirmation with those arguments verbatim; the card shows Monday's rejection and the user's submitted settings. Wait for the user to edit and approve again. If no retry arguments are returned, report the error and check Monday before considering another create. On success, use item_destination.board_id and item_destination.item_name, when present, for prepare_create_item only if the user also requested an item. Follow the latest item name the user gave. A name edit while the Create item confirmation is active belongs to that item; use prepare_create_item and never reopen this board confirmation for that edit. Omit group_id for the top group unless the user specified a group. If the item name is missing, ask for it and retain this board ID for the reply. Always show a separate Create item confirmation. If the item is cancelled or fails, report that the board was created and the item wasn't confirmed. Resume from item preparation on this board if the user retries. Never create the board again to retry the item.

tools.name: prepare_create_group
tools.title: Prepare group creation (internal)
tools.description: Start here to create an empty group (section) on an existing Monday board. Pass the board name or a verified board ID, the new group name, and any requested position. Position defaults to bottom. For before or after, pass the reference group's name or verified ID in position.reference_group. If the result includes a question, ask it and use pending_group.draft_id as replaces_draft_id when the user answers. To revise the same pending group by voice, pass replaces_draft_id and only the changed fields. For a new request, start a fresh draft. Pass create_group_arguments verbatim to create_group for confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: create_group
tools.title: Create Monday.com group
tools.description: Use create_group_arguments from prepare_create_group verbatim to show the Create group confirmation. The card lets the user edit the group name and choose top or bottom when no reference group is set. It shows the prepared board and any relative position. To change the board or relative position, ask the user to cancel and request the group again with those details. Approval creates one empty group on the reviewed board. Only report success when the result confirms the group ID. Check Monday before retrying an unconfirmed creation.

tools.name: prepare_archive_board
tools.title: Prepare board archive (internal)
tools.description: Start every Monday board archive here. If the Archive board confirmation is already open and the user wants a different board, ask them to cancel it before preparing a new confirmation. To revise a pending archive, pass the corrected board_name and replaces_draft_id, or use revises_board_name with the exact previous board name if the draft ID is missing. Use board_name for a named target or board_id for a verified selection. If both are provided, they must identify the same active board. If the result contains a question, ask it and use any matching_boards to clarify. Pass archive_board_arguments verbatim to archive_board to show a fresh confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: archive_board
tools.title: Archive Monday.com board
tools.description: Show the Archive board confirmation using archive_board_arguments from prepare_archive_board verbatim. Only approval archives the board shown. To change the board, ask the user to cancel and request archive again with the desired board. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed archive.

tools.name: prepare_delete_board
tools.title: Prepare board deletion (internal)
tools.description: Start every Monday board deletion here. Use board_name for a named target or board_id for a verified selection. If both are provided, they must identify the same active board. If the Delete board confirmation is already open and the user wants a different board, ask them to cancel it before preparing a new confirmation. To revise a pending deletion, pass replaces_draft_id or use revises_board_name with the exact previous board name if the draft ID is missing. If the result contains a question, ask it and use matching_boards to clarify. Pass delete_board_arguments verbatim to delete_board to show a fresh confirmation. This tool only reads Monday.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.title: Delete Monday.com board
tools.description: Show the Delete board confirmation using delete_board_arguments from prepare_delete_board verbatim. Approval moves the board shown to Monday.com Trash, where it can be recovered for 30 days. To change the board, ask the user to cancel and request delete again with the desired board. Report success only when Monday confirms deletion. Check Monday.com before retrying an unconfirmed deletion.

children.text: Move {{board_label}} to Monday.com Trash. It can be recovered for 30 days.

tools.name: list_board_members
tools.title: List Monday.com board members
tools.description: Use for questions like “who is on the Marketing board?” Lists the named board’s owners and direct subscribers. If a question is returned, ask it. Pass board_id only to select a board the user confirmed from matching_boards. Use the full records for follow-ups, and summarize the names and roles aloud without reading IDs. If membership cannot be verified, report the error. Read only.

tools.name: prepare_manage_users
tools.title: Prepare board membership change (internal)
tools.description: Start here for explicit requests to add existing Monday users to a board or remove direct subscribers from a board. Pass the board name and each person by name or email. Use role owner only for people the user explicitly asked to make board owners. Use me only for an explicit self-removal request. A blocked membership result ends that request. A change to the board or group on a pending Create item card belongs to prepare_create_item. If a question is returned, ask it, then retry with all clarified inputs. Pass board_id only to select a board the user confirmed from matching_boards. For a correction to a pending card, include replaces_draft_id and the complete corrected request. Pass manage_users_arguments verbatim to manage_users for confirmation. Read only.

tools.name: manage_users
tools.title: Manage Monday.com board members
tools.description: Show the confirmation card using manage_users_arguments from prepare_manage_users verbatim. Approval applies the displayed board membership changes. If the user corrects the board, people, or roles, prepare and show a new confirmation. Speak the result, including any provider errors or unconfirmed changes. Check Monday before retrying an uncertain change.
